nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk

avis.texte: I have dry skin and live in a very dry climate so I'm always on the hunt for products that will hydrate without clogging pores or cause other issues. I don't find this is the most effective cleanser when I'm wearing makeup so I tend to stick to using this when I'm wearing little to no makeup. However, the biggest con to this is the smell. At first, it just smells somewhat floral but as I've continued to use it (and I even asked my husband to make sure it wasn't just me), it smells like a port-a-potty. I don't think I would repurchase because of that alone. If it had another scent profile, I would consider purchasing when this runs out.

This is one of the most gentle cleansers I have ever used. It was so gentle that I was worried it wouldn't give me a good cleanse but it actually cleaned my face really well and left it feeling super soft and moisturized.

I've used SKIN1004's other centella products to great success, and this cleansing milk was no different. Felt great on my oily, sensitive skin, seemed like it helped reduce breakouts, and played nicely with my other products like my moisturizer and toner as well!

I love this product!! I use it daily. It has a very milky texture. It isn't harsh at all on my skin. You really don't need a lot to get the job done therefore the product will last you for a decent time! My skin after feels unbelievably smooth. It's a go to in my routine now.

I love this product. I use it everyday. It has a very milky texture and isn't harsh on my skin. You don't need a lot to get the job done. That means the product will last you for a decent time! My skin after feels unbelievably smooth. It's a go to in my routine now.
This is so hydrating and milky. It removes my makeup wonderfully and does not strip my skin nor leave it feeling dry.
I use it after I get out of the shower to clean my face again and it lol waves my skin feeling so smooth can't recommend enough!

I've been using this for a 1 week now and honestly impressed. It removes my makeup without burning my skin or making my skin feel very dry afterwards. It's a lightweight creamy texture. I have sensitive skin so something certain products burn my face but this doesn't. If you're looking for a really good cleanser I'd definitely give this a try.
I tried this for a few weeks and it was good for sensitive skin. I probably wouldnt rebuy, it didnt wow me but it was good.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. It's a very gentle creamy cleanser. I am going to use it in the morning or as a first step cleanser those days I barely wear makeup. It does not completely removes makeup and i feel like i have to use another cleanser after this to really wash my face. The scent is very light, not my favorite but ok.
I love this cleanser! It smell amazing and isn't overly scented. It doesn't dry out my skin but leave my skin feeling moisturized.

I actually really like the product sadly i didn't consider the fact that im postpartum and my hormones are crazy right now so im already breaking out and this has been kinda making it a little bit worse I do use it twice a week now though along with my acne wash and it's helping alot I also will say I LOVEEE how soft and clean it makes my skin look

It was very gentle on my skin. There was no eye stinging, or red eye. I honestly didn't see a difference in my moisture level. There was a light fragrance, no t recommended if you wear have make out mascara.
I use this as my first cleanse. It cleans away all of the makeup and dirt from the day. Scent is nice and light. Doesn't feel stripping.

I am always on the lookout for new skincare products so I was excited to try this cleansing milk! This product has a fresh, clean scent that I loved! I found the texture was nice and it lathered nicely. Overall it left my skin feeling clean and hydrated which I what I was looking for! I really enjoyed this cleansing milk!

I use alot of gentle cleansers because I have sensitive skin. This one beats them all! I've seen this a lot at the store but never bought it, so glad I received it because it's been a game changer for my skin.

avis.titre: Gentle, soothing face wash at a good price!
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I am really impressed with this face wash. I have sensitive skin and this hasn't irritated my skin at all. It has a very light fragrance that isn't bothersome, smells nice and clean. It's best applied on dry skin rather than wetting your face first. It removes dirt, residual makeup, and doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped.

avis.titre: Calming and Clear Skin Solution!!! Staple for sure!!!
avis.texte: This gentle yet soothing cleansing milk which i have incorporated in routine lately and i am glad to share that i have fallen for it! Having extremely sensitive skin this formula doesn't tingle aur burn my skin but it is also gentle on my eyes providing perfect amount of hydration and suppleness to the skin. The milky texture of the milk is so great and leaves skin dewy after the wash, i kind of skipped my moisturiser after using this once daily! Must say i'll buy it again and again beacause the benefits of this ultra gentle cleaning milk are incredible!!!

I have combination skin, and I'm always looking for a cleanser that can remove makeup and sunscreen without leaving my skin feeling dry or tight. I've been using the Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk as the first step in my evening routine, and I really like how gentle it feels on my skin. The texture is creamy and lightweight, and it spreads easily as I massage it over my face. It does a great job of dissolving my sunscreen, makeup, and daily impurities, but my skin still feels soft and comfortable after rinsing instead of stripped or squeaky clean. I especially like that it doesn't leave a greasy film behind. I also appreciate the ingredients, especially Centella Asiatica, ceramides, and multiple types of hyaluronic acid. After cleansing, my skin feels hydrated and calm, which is especially nice for my combination skin. I haven't experienced any irritation or dryness while using it. This cleansing milk has been a really nice addition to my routine. If you prefer a gentle first step cleanser that removes makeup and sunscreen while keeping your skin feeling soft and hydrated, I would definitely recommend giving this one a try. I received this product for free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review.

I received this product for sampling and I cannot lie I was a bit skeptical to use it over my current makeup remover balm but I fear I may have found my replacement product! I use false eyelashes on the daily and this product has consistently been able to remove the bits of adhesive that stays on my eyelids EVERYTIME. Product is thicker than what I'm used to but is easily spreadable and makes my skin feel great after. Will def repurchase!

avis.titre: I will definitely be getting this again!
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this cleanser! I received it to try and give an honest review and I am inlove. It can be confusing if you are used to cleanser foaming, since this one does not, but it does clean thorougly your face abd it leaves it super soft afterwards. I just do not give it 5 stars cause it does not completely remover makeup, but after using it twice or using a make up remover before it it makes wonders. Will defintively recomend and will be getting it again!

I use this product with severe psoriasis and it helps with my not so pretty side effects! Calms and soothes my skin unlike anything I have ever tried! The perfect cleanser for me! Finally a holy grail product I will keep in my routine forever!

I use this as a pre-cleanse before my regular face wash, and it seems to work much better that way. Personally, I wouldn't use it as my primary cleanser, but it's still a great product and does a good job as part of a double cleansing routine.

avis.titre: Good milky toner that hydrates the skin
avis.texte: I've been using this cleanser every day since I received it, and I've really enjoyed it. It has a nice milky texture that feels gentle on the skin and leaves my face feeling hydrated and soft after each use. I think it's especially good for dry skin because it doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or stripped. I also like the packaging—the bottle is easy to use and dispenses the right amount of product. While it does a great job of cleansing and keeping my skin comfortable, I didn't notice any significant improvements in my pores or overall skin texture. My skin looks and feels healthy

avis.titre: Gentle, but didn't leave me feeling clean
avis.texte: I have never used a milk cleanser before, so was excited to try this out and love other things I've used from this brand before. The consistency is very milky and it did feel very gentle on my skin. I do have oily skin though so unfortunately this just didn't leave me feeling very clean. My skin still felt oily afterwards, so I would probably only opt to use this is I was planning on double cleansing. The bottle is nice and I love the simplicity of this brands packaging, it looks aesthetic on a shelf.
I live this cleanser. It's gentle on my skin, doesn't leave my face feeling stripped dry. It does feel like it helps remove residue from makeup and possible dirt from the day.

avis.titre: It's not my first choice, but also not my last choice
avis.texte: I liked how it felt on my skin and will continue to use it. It felt hydrating. But, it's not great at taking off your makeup. Even minimal makeup and double cleansing.

avis.titre: Gentle cleanser that leaves my skin soft and hydrated
avis.texte: I've been using this cleansing milk as the first step of my skincare routine, and I've really enjoyed it. It gently removes sunscreen, light makeup, and daily impurities without leaving my skin feeling tight or dry. The texture is lightweight, soothing, and easy to rinse off. My skin feels clean, soft, and hydrated after every use. It's a great option for sensitive skin and anyone looking for a gentle everyday cleanser. I would definitely keep using it.

Thank you Bzzagent for providing this product in exchange for my honest review! My skin is pretty dry, so when I do a double cleanse, I like to follow up my oil cleanser with a milk cleanser instead of a water based one. I have been using this one from Skin1004 for a few days now, and I have enjoyed it so much! It has a really delicious mild but sweet scent. It's hard to place what it is—maybe honeydew? It's very light, but every time I use it I have to take a big sniff first, lol. The main thing I look for in a second step cleanser is that it removes whatever is left on my face without leaving me feeling stripped and squeaky clean. This one not only does that, but also imparts some moisture (not a film!), leaving my skin feeling nourished and calm after. I did not have any irritation or breakouts from this (no surprise since it has centella) and I have truly enjoyed testing it out! I have used other products in the centella line before, and I think that if you enjoy those, you will love this cleansing milk as well.

I've been using the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica, and it's been working really well for my skin. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a sticky feeling. Since I started using it, my skin has felt calmer and less irritated, especially when it's sensitive or dry. It also provides good hydration without feeling heavy. Overall, it's been a great addition to my skincare routine, and I would definitely recommend it if you're looking for something soothing and gentle.

This cleanser came in a beautiful blue bottle and the pump was very easy to use. I only used 2 pumps and it was enough for me. I liked that it took off all my makeup and oiliness from the day, but it didn't leave my skin feeling super dry.
This is my fav cleanser so far. It's soothing for when my skin is inflammated and gentle. Its not harsh and doesn't leave my face irritated after using.

I been using the gentle cleansing milk for a few weeks now and I really like it. It is gentle and has a soft texture. I feel it fully cleanses my face and doesn't leavea any oily residue in my skin. I think it's perfect for sensitive skin but also normal skin too.

I've been trying this for a while and so far I do like it . It doesn't break me out which is big for me I'm 40 and a lot of stuff I've found seems to not work for my skin. This leaves soft feel after I rinse it off . I've used it on a dry face and wet face feels the same. If you are looking for something gentle and no fragrance this might work for you .

When my skin is angry at me (barrier stripped, after a peel etc) this is such a nice, gentle but still effective cleanser. I dont wear makeup so I cant speak to that but it takes care of lightweight sunscreens. I have dehydrated but oily/combination skin that is acne and congestion prone. This cleanser doesnt dehydrate further, doesnt anger my skin barrier more and it doesnt break me out. I plan to continue to keep this on hand.

avis.titre: Gentle and nourishing on my face
avis.texte: The Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk was so soothing on my sensitive skin. One pump was enough to wash my entire face and the product left no residue behind and completely washed away my day's makeup. After washing off, my skin felt soft and moisturized. This product was so gentle. I absolutely loved it!
This cleanser leaves your skin feeling slightly more hydrated and seems to break me out. Doesn't leave my face feeling clean either.

I've been loving this cleansing milk! It feels so gentle on my skin but still removes sunscreen, light makeup, and daily dirt really well. My face feels clean, soft, and hydrated after every wash—never tight or stripped. The creamy texture glides on smoothly and rinses off easily. If you have sensitive or dry skin, I definitely recommend giving this a try. It's become one of my favorite gentle cleansers!

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel so soft and silk
avis.texte: I've been using this product for over a week now and it makes my skin feel so amazing and sleek
in love with this brand, amazing for sensitive skin and acne prone skin. in love with the formula and not a strong scent!

Wow, this is a great cleanser! It's thin in texture, however, it is very soothing and moisturizing. What is surprising is how clean this gets your face & neck. I do tend to get clogged pores, but not with this cleanser.
